messages:
liz_marketing: Quick sync  Hacklet: one-file refapp + 15m screencast + tiny benchmark blurb + 45m community webinar. Launch target: next Wed 14:00 PT. Volunteers?

 tom_devrel: Ill build the one-file refapp and record the 15m tutorial. Suggest a minimal todo list app that calls chat+embeddings. Keep client libs to 1 dependency.

 arya_engineer: Will run a concise benchmark: median latency and cost/1k tokens across two modes (interactive vs batch). Need sample prompts (Tom?).

 mike_growth: Ill handle landing page + registration flow. Map signups to HubSpot list "Hacklet - Webinar" and ensure UTM tagging. Quick ask: preferred CTA text?

 tom_devrel: CTAs: "Run in Browser" and "Join the Webinar". I'll add a tiny in-browser sandbox iframe for the hero.

 ops-bot: Reminder: content calendar slot reserved Wed 14:00. Staging preview: https://hacklet-preview.redwood.dev (internal).

 arya_engineer: Bench draft: interactive p50=60ms p95=220ms; batch p50=180ms p95=720ms. Uploading CSV examples to shared drive.

 liz_marketing: Great. Owners list: refapp+tuto  Tom; bench + bench writeup  Arya; landing+forms+email  Mike. Publish Wed 14:00 PT, social blast Thu 09:00 PT.

 tom_devrel: Pushed repo with run instructions and tiny curl example. Command: `python hacklet.py --model open-small`. Also added fallback guidance for OOM.

 mike_growth: Draft landing copy in Figma. I'll wire HubSpot webhook -> SFDC mapping. Will run an email to existing dev list + X thread.

 liz_marketing: Please paste preview links and any promo assets here before Tue EOD. If blockers, call them out now."
